weeks.content:
Methods of solving quadratic equations:
factorization, completing the square, quadratic
formula; word problems.

Meaning; derivation of tangent and normal
equations; applications in coordinate geometry.

Definition; degree of polynomials; addition,
subtraction, multiplication; long division.

Factor and remainder theorem; applications in
simplifying algebraic expressions.

Application of factor and remainder theorem;
solving higher order equations.

Factorization of cubic expressions; methods of
solution.

Statements; truth table; negation, conjunction,
disjunction.

Conditional and biconditional statements;
tautology and contradiction.

Definition; values of trigonometric ratios; angle of
elevation and depression.

Sine, cosine, and tangent graphs; properties and
transformations.

weeks.topic: Trigonometric Identity & Graphs of Inverse Trigonometric Ratios; applications of Pythagoras theorem. Pythagoras Theorem
